preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of operations m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.
The number of operations is exactly m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation specifies two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= ci <= n - 1 for ci in result)
postconditions.description: Each ci is a non-negative integer less than or equal to n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(ci == sum(1 for j in range(1, n + 1) if i != j and any(x in node_lists[i] for x in node_lists[j])) for i, ci in enumerate(result, start=1))
postconditions.description: Each ci is the count of nodes j (j ≠ i) such that the lists of nodes i and j have at least one common number.
